i.norm:
Tests for {@link Tag#valueOf(String)} input validation and case-insensitivity behaviour.
  • {@link #valueOfChecksNotNull()} – passing {@code null} must throw {@link IllegalArgumentException}.
  • {@link #canBeInsensitive(Locale)} – tag lookup must be case-insensitive in all locales.
Verifies that {@link Tag#valueOf(String)} rejects a {@code null} tag name by throwing {@link IllegalArgumentException}, preventing silent null-pointer failures downstream.

Verifies that tag lookup is case-insensitive regardless of the JVM's default {@link Locale}. Both the static {@link Tag#valueOf} factory and the {@link TagSet}-based lookup are covered: the static factory returns equal (but potentially distinct) instances, while the {@link TagSet} lookup must return the exact same cached instance ({@code assertSame}).
